label: Lenalidomide
intro: Lenalidomide is cleared mainly by the kidneys, so renal function dominates its special-population evidence. The platform holds the dedicated renal study CC-5013-PK-001 (from the EMA assessment), two population PK models with renal covariates (Hughes 2019, Kim 2026), their locked outside checks against that study, and their enforced scopes, and the REVLIMID prescribing information (revision 3/2023). The renal study enrolled people whose kidney impairment was due to non-malignant conditions, with healthy controls, not patients with myeloma; both models were fitted in patients with haematological cancer.

Decrease in clearance (%) with moderate and severe impairment compared with healthy subjects; half-life about 3-fold longer. The label threshold for the first dose step (60 mL/min) differs from the 50 mL/min in the platform's earlier secondary source.
kidney.population: Single 25 mg dose; label group sizes: 3 healthy, 8 mild, 9 moderate, 4 severe, 6 on dialysis

kidney.text: Hughes 2019: clearance scales with creatinine clearance as (CrCl / 90 mL/min) to this power (with fat-free mass).
Kim 2026: clearance rises exponentially with eGFR; coefficient per mL/min/1.73 m2 (estimate) around a reference of 46.92.
Hughes 2019 creatinine clearance bands and evidence tiers on the platform (36-50 mL/min is flagged: the model under-predicted the moderate group about 2-fold).

value.band_note: Normal (> 80 mL/min) and mild (50-80) groups: exposure consistent with study CC-5013-PK-001 in all four scenarios (external_check_report).
Moderate group (30-50 mL/min): the model under-predicted exposure about 2.1-fold (ratio to normal 2.2-fold) in all four scenarios (external_check_report). Read the curve as substantially too low.

kidney.text: Kim 2026 eGFR bands and evidence tiers on the platform (11.1-30 and 30-50 are flagged: the model under-predicted the severe and moderate groups about 1.3-fold).

value.band_note: Mild group (creatinine clearance 50-80 mL/min): ratio to normal consistent in all seven scenarios; normal-group exposure consistent in six of seven (external_check_report). The study groups are defined by creatinine clearance; Kim's covariate is indexed eGFR, so band edges are approximate.

Moderate group (creatinine clearance 30-50 mL/min): ratio to normal under-predicted about 1.3-fold in the primary scenario of the 2.1e recheck and in all four of its scenarios (recheck_report; applicability_findings renal-under-prediction-moderate); the first check (2.1c) had found it consistent in the primary scenario only. Most of the group’s constructed eGFR values fell below 30, so this band edge is approximate. Read the curve as possibly somewhat low.

Severe group (< 30 mL/min): ratio to normal under-predicted about 1.3-fold in the primary scenario (five of seven scenarios in 2.1c; all four in the 2.1e recheck); half-life reproduced (applicability_findings renal-under-prediction-severe). Read the curve as possibly somewhat low.

other_covariates.text: Sex, race and type of haematological malignancy: no clinically relevant effect on clearance in adults (label).
other_covariates.value: Other Intrinsic Factors: Age (39 to 85 years), body weight (33 to 135 kg), sex, race, and type of hematological malignancies (MM, MDS or MCL) did not have a clinically relevant effect on lenalidomide clearance in adult patients.

not_this: A research summary of sourced findings. Not dosing guidance: the label's dose adjustments are quoted as the label states them, and the platform proposes no dose.

supersedes.change: Renal study population recorded (non-malignant renal impairment; healthy controls); sources moved to renal evidence v2, Hughes scope v2 and Kim scope v3 (moderate eGFR band now flagged).
